head: 6b8f624311b0a4a1093d7e55e35fd3f1683a38a4
summary: Reusable protocol-24 headless bot clients, bounded action scripts, CLI patrol and authoritative action integrations. Independent code review and merged QA remain pending.

verify.botIntegration: 6 tests passed, all seven required actions accepted plus explicit refusal, correction, liveness and handoff coverage

decisions: Use Node built-in WebSocket on the existing Node >=22 runtime; no new dependency or lockfile changes needed.
Movement actions wait for authoritative snapshots; corrections stop and rebase the route, exposing a BotRefusal to the caller.
Explicit waypoints and mode transitions provide reusable e2e primitives; the default load script is a flight patrol, separately verified from action integrations.
The accept-quest integration obtains a genuine offer through the existing runtime offer hook because world quest-giver/board interaction is outside this task.
outOfScope: P1.E16.T02 50-bot budget and future active-pirate workload
Independent review and merged QA, owned by the parent
